//RomCache: Just-in-time ROM cache (docs/arcade-jit-cache.md). Leave ManifestPath/RomsDir empty to disable (gateway = pure signaling proxy). ManifestPath = the file arcade-romcache-export writes; RomsDir = the same host path as compose ROMS_DIR (D:\ArcadeStorage\roms — the workers mount it read-only). MaxBytes caps extracted JIT ROMs on disk.
//SaveStore: Durable per-user save store (docs/arcade-saves-plan.md). Leave StoreDir/SavesMountDir empty to disable (saves stay room-scoped, current behavior). StoreDir = durable blobs (D:\ArcadeStorage\savestore); SavesMountDir = the same host path as compose SAVES_DIR (D:\ArcadeStorage\saves — CloudRetro's working dir the gateway seeds into / harvests from). MaxBytes caps the store; HarvestDebounceMs coalesces autosave writes.
